lines: Author: Dr M. Ellerscombe, Senior In Vitro Biologist

blocks.p: This note hands over the biology items I am carrying on the hERG channel screen and the control-lot checks before my last week. Items I have not closed are listed in section 5. Where a decision is still open I have left the placeholder rather than guess at it.
The note is for Leila and Ravi. Anika has seen the first version only.
A compound is repeated when its control response falls outside the window on the day it was run. The repeat is run on a fresh sample card, not on the original test lot.

list: Repeat the whole compound set when the E-4031 reference is outside its window

list.text: Do not repeat single compounds that fall in a flagged cell; flag them instead

list: Repeats are run at the same concentrations as the first run
Repeat count per compound: [TBC] (I have not agreed this with Gerda and Nikos)

blocks.p: Where a compound gives a reproducible result in the repeat, the repeat is the one reported. Where the two runs disagree, both are kept on the record and the study director decides.
The reference lot change in June needs a bridging check before the screening sets from that month are released. I have not finished the bridging comparison.

list: Bridging run on the old and new reference lot, same plate layout
Compare the control IC50 on both lots against the acceptance record
Check whether the June screening sets need a note in the biology memo
